description: This file defines a PHP trait 'RequestTrait' that provides common behaviors for HTTP request objects, including methods for initializing request state, managing request target, HTTP method, and URI, and handling headers according to PSR-7 standards.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the request state, setting method, URI, stream, and headers, and handling the Host header based on the URI.

methods.name: createUri
methods.description: Creates and returns a UriInterface instance based on input, accepting UriInterface, string, or null.

methods.name: getRequestTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the request target, defaulting to '/' if none is set.

methods.name: withRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified request target, validating for whitespace.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method of the request.

methods.name: withMethod
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified HTTP method, validating the method string.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the UriInterface instance associated with the request.

methods.name: withUri
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified URI, optionally preserving the Host header.

methods.name: setMethod
methods.description: Validates and sets the HTTP method.

methods.name: getHostFromUri
methods.description: Constructs and returns the host string from the URI, including port if present.
